reports.title: Ionic Digital Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: Ionic Digital is reaffirming its full-year 2026 outlook. Given year-to-date results, the Company expects cryptocurrency mining revenue to meet or exceed the mid-point of its range below.

($ in millions) | Full Year 2026
Digital infrastructure leasing revenue | $175
Cryptocurrency mining revenue | $15 | to | $20
Total Revenue | $190 | to | $195
Adjusted EBITDA(1) | $137.5 | to | $142.5
Capital Expenditures(2) | $45 | to | $60
